name: Palabra - Fix Android Spanish speech
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
permissions:
  contents: write
jobs:
  fix:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Improve speech fallback and add direct TTS test button
        shell: bash
        run: |
          python3 - <<'PYFIX'
            from pathlib import Path
            p=Path('index.html')
            s=p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
            start=s.index('function fallbackSpanishSpeech(es,token){')
            end=s.index('async function speak(es){',start)
            fix="""function fallbackSpanishSpeech(es,token){
              if(!('speechSynthesis' in window)||!('SpeechSynthesisUtterance' in window)){
                setAudioStatus('本浏览器不支持语音合成。');return;
              }
              const engine=window.speechSynthesis;
              function run(){
                if(token!==audioToken)return;
                const spanish=engine.getVoices().filter(v=>/^es(?:-|_)/i.test(v.lang));
                if(!spanish.length){
                  setAudioStatus('没有检测到西班牙语语音包；请在安卓的文字转语音设置中安装西班牙语，再点击「合成发音测试」。');return;
                }
                const voice=spanish.find(v=>/^es[-_]ES$/i.test(v.lang))||spanish[0];
                const speech=new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(es);
                speech.lang=voice.lang;speech.voice=voice;speech.rate=.88;speech.pitch=1.04;
                speech.onstart=()=>{if(token===audioToken)setAudioStatus('🗣️ 合成语音 '+es+' · '+voice.lang+'（非真人录音）')};
                speech.onerror=e=>{if(token===audioToken)setAudioStatus('合成语音失败：'+e.error+'。请检查安卓语音引擎与声音设置。')};
                engine.cancel();engine.speak(speech);
              }
              if(engine.getVoices().some(v=>/^es(?:-|_)/i.test(v.lang))){run();return;}
              setAudioStatus('正在加载安卓系统的西班牙语语音列表…');
              let done=false;const old=engine.onvoiceschanged;
              engine.onvoiceschanged=function(e){if(typeof old==='function')old.call(engine,e);if(!done){done=true;run();}};
              setTimeout(()=>{if(!done){done=true;run()}},1500);
            }
            """
            s=s[:start]+fix+s[end:]
            # Give failed Commons playback the same fallback instead of swallowing the chance to synthesize.
            old="const entry=commonsSamples[word];if(entry){let url='https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/Special:Redirect/file/'+encodeURIComponent(entry.file);await playURL(url,token,es+' · '+entry.label);return}"
            new="const entry=commonsSamples[word];if(entry){let url='https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/Special:Redirect/file/'+encodeURIComponent(entry.file);try{await playURL(url,token,es+' · '+entry.label);return}catch(e){if(token!==audioToken)return}}"
            if old not in s:raise RuntimeError('Cannot find Commons playback to update')
            s=s.replace(old,new,1)
            # Provide an explicit user-triggered button: user gestures help speech playback on mobile.
            old='<button id="speak">🔊 西语发音</button>'
            new='<button id="speak">🔊 西语发音</button><button type="button" id="ttsTry">🗣️ 合成发音测试</button>'
            if old not in s:raise RuntimeError('Cannot find speech button')
            s=s.replace(old,new,1)
            needle="$('testVoice').onclick=()=>speak('hola');"
            if needle not in s:raise RuntimeError('Cannot locate voice handlers')
            s=s.replace(needle,"$('ttsTry').onclick=()=>{stopAudio();fallbackSpanishSpeech($('es').textContent.trim()||'hola',audioToken)};\n"+needle,1)
            p.write_text(s,encoding='utf-8')
            print('Patched index.html: '+str(len(s))+' characters')
          PYFIX
      - name: Commit update
        run: |
          git config user.name 'github-actions[bot]'
          git config user.email '41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com'
          git add index.html
          if ! git diff --cached --quiet; then
            git commit -m 'Fix Android Spanish speech fallback and add test button'
            git push
          fi
